messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: kobieta (formy żeńskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Pracuje w sklepie zoologicznym w Olsztynie; pisze rano przed otwarciem albo wieczorem po zmianie.
- zainteresowania: akwaria roślinne, gry na telefonie, domowe gofry
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: przystanek przy ulicy Jarockiej w Olsztynie
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Przestawia regały w mieszkaniu i urządza miejsce na nowe akwarium.
- sposób pisania: zdania: short fragments; interpunkcja: prawie bez przecinków; wielkie litery: all lowercase; literówki: frequent (missing diacritics, swapped letters); skróty: some (nwm, jj, bd, wgl); emoji: rare
- tik językowy: często pisze „a tu proszę”

For each of the 17 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. zwierzęta - ptaki na balkonie / karmnik (early morning, Friday)
2. sport - skoki narciarskie / siatkówka / żużel w TV (afternoon, Tuesday)
3. jedzenie i gotowanie - nieudane ciasto / danie (evening, Sunday)
4. technologia i sprzęt - padła bateria / ładowarka (lunch break, Saturday)
5. zakupy i ceny - zwrot / reklamacja (bez gniewu, drobne) (afternoon, Friday)
6. praca i grafik - zmiana grafiku w pracy (lunch break, Wednesday)
7. zdrowie i sen - kawa i sen, ironicznie (late night, Wednesday)
8. praca i grafik - praca zdalna, domowe biuro (lunch break, Monday)
9. dzieci i rodzina - urodziny, prezent (evening, Friday)
10. gry i seriale - zakup na promocji na Steamie (early morning, Tuesday)
11. praca i grafik - wypłata, premia, rozliczenie (afternoon, Wednesday)
12. zdrowie i sen - ból pleców od siedzenia (lunch break, Tuesday)
13. praca i grafik - przerwa, kawa, stołówka (early morning, Tuesday)
14. drobne narzekanie na usługi - urząd, kolejka, numerek (late morning, Tuesday)
15. pogoda - mgła rano (lunch break, Saturday)
16. jedzenie i gotowanie - śniadanie w biegu (early morning, Monday)
17. komunikacja i dojazdy - rower do pracy (late night, Monday)

Return a JSON array of 17 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
